card.name: Linking words inside drug example lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a named drug in an example list, such as 'such as linezolid and' or 'avanafil,'. The next word is another drug name.

modes.label: After first listed drug
modes.description: A comma or 'and' follows the first drug in an 'such as' or 'e.g.' list of interacting drugs.
modes.example: such as avanafil<<,>> sildenafil, tadalafil, or varden

modes.label: Joining two named agents
modes.description: 'and' links a drug to another agent in an interaction warning.
modes.example: such as linezolid<< and>> intravenous methylene blue). Monoamine

modes.label: Other drug-name settings
modes.description: Words like 'as' or 'approximate' just before a drug name, or a split inside a drug name.
modes.example: nitric oxide donors (such<< as>> amyl nitrite) in any form

card.writes: It likely makes the model less ready for ordinary words and more ready for a drug name to come next.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a drug list where the next word will be another drug name.
